key_capabilities.note: The home page has a section titled 'Live Session Listening and Feedback' with an 'Observational AI' mock-up, but the paragraph under it describes consulting and custom AI projects ('we offer strategic consulting and develop custom AI projects'), so live listening is not listed as a feature. Home also announces 'moving avatars'. FieldX adds LMS connection via LTI, role-based access, timesheets, a form builder and a site directory with a live map; it states 'FERPA- and HIPAA-aligned, with SOC 2 Type II certification'. Catalog course titles include Introduction to Counseling, Career Counseling, Multicultural Counseling, Ethical & Legal Issues, Counseling Theories and Techniques, and Marriage, Couple and Family Counseling.
